## The idea

&nbsp;

> We adopt a broad [**interdisciplinary**]{.fragment .highlight-current-red fragment-index="1"} and [**analytical**]{.fragment .highlight-current-red fragment-index="2"} perspective, drawing [**selectively**]{.fragment .highlight-current-red fragment-index="3"} on a vast literature on social order and social control. ... we ask how social order is produced, who exercises control, and how the legitimate and illegitimate uses of [**violence**]{.fragment .highlight-current-red fragment-index="4"} are defined and contested.
